_note: Original summaries of Spycraft 2.0 rules text (Open Game Content), written for this system. Keys match names in the other src/data files.

feats.Armor Basics: Pick partial, moderate or full armor; armor of that type works better for you (more DR vs. melee, smaller Defense and armor check penalties, harder to spot).
feats.Armor Mastery: Your Armor Basics applies to a second armor type; in chosen armor you gain +1 Defense and can only be Coup de Graced while helpless.
feats.Armor Supremacy: Armor Basics and Mastery apply to every armor type; worn armor gives +1 DR against all attacks and protects you from sneak attack damage.
feats.Bandage: Medicine counts as a class skill. First Aid and Stabilize no longer need a kit, and with a kit your career level adds to the vitality points restored.
feats.Battle Hardened: Gain 2 points of stress damage resistance; Cover Fire and Suppressive Fire aimed at you impose only a –1 penalty.
feats.Superior Cover: While in cover you can take –2 to attack and skill checks for a round to gain DR equal to your cover's Reflex bonus.
feats.Combat Expertise: Each Initiative Count, trade a penalty to attack and skill checks (up to your base Defense, max 6) for an equal dodge bonus to Defense.
feats.Expert Disarm: +2 to Disarm attacks; losing a Disarm doesn't leave you flat-footed or open to a counter-disarm, and Disarm crits cost 1 less action die.
feats.Combat Instincts: Once per round, when an adjacent foe misses you by 5 or more and you're not flat-footed, make a free final attack against them.
feats.Opportunist: Once per round, when a second foe you both can see is stunned or drops below 0 wounds, make a free half-damage final attack on your opponent.
feats.Combat Mobility: You can Standard Move away from adjacent foes, move double Speed while taking Total Defense, and turn more freely while running.
feats.Mobile Defense: Running doesn't make you flat-footed; when you move you can lower your Initiative Count by 2 for +2 dodge Defense for a round.
feats.Mobile Offense: Once per round, make a free final attack at any point during a Standard Move.
feats.Containment Basics: With a 2-to-1 advantage, your team's successful Ambush benefits last through the surprise round and the first 3 combat rounds.
feats.Containment Mastery: With a 2-to-1 advantage, take a Diversion or Taunt as a free action once per round.
feats.Containment Supremacy: With a 2-to-1 advantage, every opponent you can see moves at half Speed.
feats.Contempt: Once per round, make a free final attack against a standard character; usable a number of times per combat equal to your starting action dice.
feats.Explosive Basics: Explosives you place are harder to find (+4 DC) and harder to dodge (+2 Reflex DC), and your error range when setting them drops by 2.
feats.Fire-Team Basics: With a 2-to-1 advantage, take Cover Fire as a free action once per round.
feats.Fire-Team Mastery: With a 2-to-1 advantage, Stabilize as a free action once per round, and wounded or dead teammates come with you when you leave combat.
feats.Fire-Team Supremacy: With a 2-to-1 advantage, make one free final attack each round.
feats.Great Fortitude: +3 base Fortitude save and 3 extra wound points.
feats.Guts: +4 to Forced March, Power Lifting and Speed Push, ignore fatigue penalties, and roll better on the Table of Ouch.
feats.Quick Healer: You recover vitality and wounds, and shake off stress and subdual damage, in half the usual time.
feats.Horde Basics: You and teammates gain 1/4 personal cover at 2-to-1 advantage, 1/2 cover at 3-to-1.
feats.Horde Mastery: With a 2-to-1 advantage, you and teammates can Pummel as a half action and gain +1 to Grapple skill checks.
feats.Horde Supremacy: With a 2-to-1 advantage, your team gets +2 damage within CQB Range and enemy Initiative Count gains are halved.
feats.Iron Will: +3 base Will save; Con and Wis count as 3 higher for subdual and stress thresholds.
feats.Lightning Reflexes: +3 base Reflex save, and roll Initiative twice keeping the better result.
feats.Quick Draw: Twice per round, Draw, Holster, Pick Up or Reload a weapon as a free action.
feats.Snake Strike: Once per foe per combat, draw an unused weapon and Feint for free; success adds a sneak attack die to your next hit with it this round.
feats.Surge of Speed: Once per round, take an extra non-attack half action for free; usable a number of times per session equal to your starting action dice.
feats.Tac-Squad Basics: With a 2-to-1 advantage, once per round Threaten for free or make an Intimidate/Coercion check as a half action.
feats.Tac-Squad Mastery: With a 2-to-1 advantage, take Suppressive Fire as a half action once per round.
feats.Tac-Squad Supremacy: With a 2-to-1 advantage, every opponent in your CQB Range and line of sight counts as flanked.
feats.Tactical Advantage: You and each teammate count as 2 characters for numerical advantage, and Joint Actions you join get an easier DC.
feats.Toughness: Gain vitality points equal to your base Fortitude bonus. Can be taken up to 3 times.
feats.Two-Weapon Basics: Hands-On penalty for one-handed use drops to –2; when wielding two one-handed weapons you may take an extra final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.
feats.Two-Weapon Mastery: When using Two-Weapon Basics, raise the penalty to –4 to gain a second extra final attack.
feats.Weapon Focus: Gain the forte for one proficiency (not Unarmed) and much easier Build/Modify/Repair DCs for its weapons. Can be taken multiple times.
feats.Wolfpack Basics: Your bonus against flanked opponents rises to +4.
feats.Wolfpack Mastery: Foes are flanked whenever you and a teammate are both adjacent to them, and your hits on flanked foes add 1 sneak attack die.
feats.Wolfpack Supremacy: +1 threat range against flanked foes and another sneak attack die (2 total) when you hit them.
feats.All-out Attack: Before a melee attack, take a penalty up to Str mod + 2 to gain twice that in damage; you're flat-footed if you miss.
feats.Axe Basics: Readied axes gain armor-piercing 2 and +1 to Trip and Disarm; also grants an axe stance and trick.
feats.Battering Blows: Grants a grapple trick that lets you strike a held foe with both your unarmed and your weapon damage.
feats.Cleave Basics: Once per round, when a melee attack drops a foe, make one more melee attack on another opponent.
feats.Cleave Mastery: Cleave any number of times per round, and +1 melee threat range against standard characters.
feats.Cleave Supremacy: Move 5 ft. before each cleave attack, and melee crits against standard characters cost 1 less action die.
feats.Club Basics: Swap lethal/subdual damage freely with clubs, use improvised clubs without penalty, and gain a club stance and trick.
feats.Darting Weapon: At the start of your Initiative Count, take an extra melee or hurled final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.
feats.Flashing Weapon: With Darting Weapon, accept –4 instead to gain a second extra final attack.
feats.Dueling Basics: Choose a foe each round for +2 dodge Defense against them (or +1 vs. everyone), and occasionally strike 5 ft. beyond your Reach.
feats.Dueling Mastery: +1 Defense with a readied melee weapon; adjacent foes who miss you lose 2 Initiative Count; you can use weapons in unarmed stances.
feats.Dueling Supremacy: +2 dodge Defense, and each melee hit raises your Initiative Count by 1.
feats.Fencing Basics: With a one-handed finesse sword, +2 to Feint and Disarm; also grants a fencing stance and trick.
feats.Finesse Basics: Any one-handed melee weapon can gain the finesse quality, and massive two-handers don't cost you Initiative.
feats.Finesse Supremacy: Another +1 melee threat range (2 total), and melee crits cost 1 less action die.
feats.Flail Basics: With a readied flail, +2 to Cheap Shot attacks and Feints; also grants a flail stance and trick.
feats.Garrote Basics: With a garrote, +2 threat range on Grapple checks and held foes can't speak; also grants a stance and grapple trick.
feats.Great Sword Basics: With a two-handed sword, +2 Defense vs. melee and vs. Trips; also grants a power stance and trick.
feats.Hammer Basics: Readied hammers gain armor-piercing 2 and give +2 to Intimidate; also grants a stance that knocks foes back and a trick.
feats.Improvised Weapon Basics: +3 to Gear checks for improvised weapons and no gear penalty when using them.
feats.Improvised Weapon Mastery: Pick what improvised weapon you find, always within reach, and once per combat find one without spending an action die.
feats.Knife Basics: Draw knives as a free action and they're always readied; also grants a knife stance and trick.
feats.Polearm Basics: +1 Defense with a readied polearm and no penalty attacking adjacent foes; also grants a stance and trick.
feats.Spear Basics: +2 to Bull Rush and Trip with a readied spear; also grants a stance and a charging trick.
feats.Staff Basics: +3 to Jump checks with a readied staff; also grants a stance against flanking and a trick.
feats.Sword Basics: After a hit with a non-finesse one-handed sword, step to the far side of your foe; also grants a stance and trick.
feats.Whip Basics: +2 to Jump and Trip with a readied whip; also grants a stance and an entangling trick.
feats.Autofire Basics: Use a Two-Shot Burst with Single-Shot or Burst weapons, and take Cover Fire as a half action once per round.
feats.Autofire Mastery: When you hit a foe with a ranged attack, teammates get +2 to hit them for a round; Bursts don't raise your error range.
feats.Autofire Supremacy: Autofire scores an extra hit per 3 points over Defense, and Strafe targets gain less Defense.
feats.Bombard: Indirect attacks get double range increment, –1 error range, harder damage-reduction DCs, and you roll deviation twice on a miss.
feats.Bullseye: Before a single-shot ranged attack, take a penalty up to Dex mod + 2 for an equal damage bonus; flat-footed if you miss.
feats.CQB Basics: +1 to ranged attacks and damage within CQB Range, +2 to Threaten with a readied ranged weapon, and no penalty shooting out of melee.
feats.CQB Mastery: +1 ranged threat range within CQB Range and better Threaten actions with a readied ranged weapon.
feats.CQB Supremacy: Cover of nearby foes counts as 1/4 less, +5 Initiative with a readied ranged weapon, and a free attack if your Threaten fails.
feats.Flamethrower Basics: Flamethrowers ignore imprecise, use half the shots, and can use the Bounce trick.
feats.Follow-up Shot: At the start of your Initiative Count, take an extra firearm or heavy-weapon final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.
feats.Hail of Fire: With Follow-up Shot, accept –4 instead to gain a second extra final attack.
feats.Grenade Basics: Thrown grenades gain +5 ft. range increment and –2 error range, Bounce is easier, and grenade requests yield one extra.
feats.Guided Weapon Basics: Guided attacks get double range increment and –1 error range, guided ammo requests are doubled, and you roll deviation twice on a miss.
feats.Gunslinger's Eye: As a free action, size up a character's ranged attack bonus, Initiative bonus and Ranged Combat feats; uses per session equal to your Ranged Combat feats.
feats.Marksmanship Basics: Brace for free whenever you Aim, even with nothing to brace against, and bracing only costs –1 Reflex.
feats.Marksmanship Mastery: +1 to Aim bonuses, +50% firearm/heavy weapon range increment and double hurled range increment.
feats.Marksmanship Supremacy: CQB Range extends to 60 ft.; firearm range increments double and hurled range increments triple.
feats.Revolver Basics: Readied revolvers can fire in Burst mode, give +4 Intimidate when holding a single round, and reload fully as a free action once per round.
feats.Rock and Roll: Autofire and Strafe volleys use only 2 shots each; fire rifles and machine guns one-handed at –2; requests for autofire ammo yield double.
feats.Sharpshooter Basics: Your ranged attacks reduce a target's cover by 1/4 and halve Defense bonuses from Size.
feats.Sharpshooter Mastery: +1 threat range on braced ranged attacks and Called Shot penalty reduced by 3.
feats.Sharpshooter Supremacy: +2 threat range on aimed ranged attacks, and ranged crits cost 1 less action die.
feats.Snap Shot: Once per round, when a ranged attack drops a foe, immediately take another shot at a different opponent.
feats.Steel Rain: Hurled weapons are drawn freely and always readied, can Burst, Cover Fire and Suppressive Fire, and are easier to stash.
feats.Style Over Caliber: Pistols can deal a flat 1d10+2 base damage instead of their normal damage, and Cheap Shots with pistols are easier.
feats.This… is my Boomstick: Club foes with a readied shotgun, fire it one-handed at –2, raise its save DCs by 4, and knock targets back 5 ft. on a hit.
feats.Trick Shot: A lethal hit with a non-grenade hurled weapon can hold the target instead of damaging them.
feats.Berserker Basics: As a full action, rage for 2d4+2 rounds: +3 Str and Con and enraged; you're exhausted afterwards.
feats.Berserker Mastery: Enter rage as a free action; rages last 3d4+3 rounds and grant +5 Str and Con.
feats.Berserker Supremacy: End rage freely; rages last 4d4+4 rounds, +4 to resist frenzy, and you're only fatigued afterwards.
feats.Boxing Basics: +2 wound points, plus a boxing stance and trick.
feats.Boxing Moves: Gain boxing tricks that can knock out or daze standard characters.
feats.Boxing Supremacy: +1 Con and powerful charging and finishing punch tricks.
feats.Brawling Basics: +2 Initiative, plus a brawling stance and grapple trick.
feats.Brawling Moves: Gain brawling tricks such as body slams and feints that boost your Defense.
feats.Brawling Supremacy: Two unarmed hits on one foe in a round earn a free final attack; gain tricks such as double-damage combos.
feats.Dirty Fighting Basics: Sneak attack damage against you is halved; gain a dirty-fighting stance and trick.
feats.Dirty Fighting Moves: Gain underhanded tricks such as blinding eye gouges and improved feints.
feats.Dirty Fighting Supremacy: Unarmed hits deal +1 sneak attack die; gain brutal finishing tricks.
feats.Kicking Basics: Kicks don't lower your Initiative Count; gain a kicking stance and trick.
feats.Kicking Moves: Gain mobile and high-threat kicking tricks.
feats.Kicking Supremacy: +1 Dex and a flurry-of-kicks trick among others.
feats.Martial Arts: Unarmed threat range 19–20 and 1d6 unarmed damage; pick an attribute to apply to Defense/Initiative (or unarmed attacks).
feats.Master's Arts: Unarmed threat range 17–20 and +1d6 unarmed damage; your Martial Arts attribute also adds to unarmed attacks, damage, Defense and Initiative.
feats.Rolling Basics: Stand Up is free and safe; gain a rolling stance and trick.
feats.Rolling Moves: Gain acrobatic tricks to reposition around and through enemies when attacking.
feats.Rolling Supremacy: +10 ft. Speed plus defensive and charging tricks.
feats.Spirit Basics: Once per combat reduce lethal damage from one source by your BAB; gain a spirit stance and trick.
feats.Spirit Moves: Gain tricks such as intimidating warnings and shattering weapons.
feats.Spirit Supremacy: +1 Wis and tricks that turn foes' attacks back on them or let you move freely before striking.
feats.Submission Basics: Cheap Shot penalties from your unarmed hits are doubled; gain a ground-fighting stance and trick.
feats.Submission Moves: Gain grapple tricks that sap attributes and lock joints.
feats.Submission Supremacy: Cheap Shot a foe repeatedly (different penalty each time) and gain lethal grapple tricks.
feats.Two-hit Combo: At the start of your Initiative Count, take an extra unarmed final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.
feats.Warrior's Grace: With Two-hit Combo, accept –4 instead to gain a second extra unarmed final attack.
feats.Vital Points Basic: Gain 6 points of sneak attack damage resistance, plus a stance and trick.
feats.Vital Points Moves: Gain pressure-point tricks that can stun or exploit flat-footed foes.
feats.Vital Points Supremacy: Unarmed hits deal +1 sneak attack die; gain paralyzing and crippling tricks.
feats.Wrestling Basics: +1 Defense against adjacent foes; gain a wrestling stance and trick.
feats.Wrestling Moves: Gain takedown tricks like clotheslines and hip tosses.
feats.Wrestling Supremacy: +1 Str and devastating throw and back-breaker tricks.
feats.All or Nothing: Once per session, widen a roll's threat and error ranges by 5 each.
feats.Better Luck Next Time: If an action die spent on a skill check or save rolls a natural 1, you get it back.
feats.Fortune's Fool: When an opponent spends an action die to turn your error into a critical failure, you may swap one of your dice for theirs.
feats.Black Cat: Once per scene, curse opponents in sight (up to your Chance feats): their error ranges rise by 2 for the scene.
feats.Jinx: Activating an opponent's error costs 1 less action die; uses per session equal to your Chance feats.
feats.Tough Luck: Foes hit by your Black Cat must spend an extra action die to activate threats.
feats.The Dice are Hot: No result cap on Gambling, a synergy bonus equal to your action dice, and +1 Lifestyle.
feats.Fortunate: Request an extra d4 action die (the GC or an opponent also gets one); uses per session tied to your Chance feats.
feats.Fortune Favors the Bold: Every action die you gain is one die type larger.
feats.Lady Luck's Smile: Your action dice explode on their two highest results.
feats.Lucky Break: Once per scene, an attack or check against you that succeeds by 1 or less fails instead.
feats.Misfortune: When you score an unused threat against a special character, spend an action die to make them discard one.
feats.Peculiar Dodge: When hit, roll a non-exploding action die; on an odd result the attack misses. Uses per session tied to your Chance feats.
feats.Mark of Conflict: +1 ranged damage; BAB and level count 3 higher for Ranged Combat feat prerequisites; other ranged experts dislike you.
feats.Mark of Strife: +1 unarmed damage; BAB and level count 3 higher for Unarmed Combat feat prerequisites; other brawlers dislike you.
feats.Mark of Turmoil: +1 melee damage; BAB and level count 3 higher for Melee Combat feat prerequisites; other melee experts dislike you.
feats.Trouble Magnet: Take on one additional Subplot, but you must always have at least one active. Can be taken twice.
feats.Baby It: Once per scene, a vehicle you drive ignores a critical hit until the scene ends.
feats.Demolition Derby: Vehicles you drive get +2 Damage saves and take 1 less point per die of collision damage.
feats.Death Ride: While driving or riding, gain DR equal to your Chase feats and stay conscious at negative wounds until you stop.
feats.Bail Out!: Crash damage is much reduced for you, and as Prey you can attempt Long Gone at any time at the cost of a crash.
feats.Daredevil: Choose chase Strategies as if Acceleration and Turning were 2 higher, and gain access to the Stunt Strategy.
feats.Crew Dog: Once per scene in a crewed vehicle, gain a bonus d6 action die for vehicle-related rolls (or pass it to a crewmate).
feats.Lane Dancer: Ground vehicles treat maneuvering room as one step wider, and +2 on Crisis Advantage checks in ground chases.
feats.Mount Up: Your mount uses your Defense and Reflex if better, treats maneuvering room as wider, and you get +2 on mounted Crisis Advantage checks.
feats.Photo Finish: In a chase, lower your own Acceleration and Turning by 2 to lower everyone else's by 2 too.
feats.Wave Runner: Hold your breath longer, treat watercraft maneuvering room as wider, and +2 on Crisis Advantage checks in water chases.
feats.Wind Rider: Halved visual-range Notice penalty, better gliding, and air vehicles treat maneuvering room as wider with +2 on Crisis Advantage checks.
feats.Dash: Run at up to 5× Speed, jump 25% farther with a running start, and get chase advantages while on foot.
feats.Defensive Driving: Halved Maneuver penalties from Prey Strategies, and once per chase force a foe to suffer a Crisis Advantage.
feats.Jackrabbit Start: As Prey in a chase or manhunt, start with +2 Lead and every Strategy offers you the Lead Advantage.
feats.Driving Instincts: Guess your opponent's chase Strategy; if right, they take a penalty equal to your Chase feats on their next Maneuver check.
feats.Professional Driver - Closed Course: Impress gives synergy to your Maneuver checks, and Acrobatics/Drive give synergy to Impress when people can see you drive.
feats.Duct Tape and Bubblegum: A vehicle you're in gains a Damage save bonus of half your Mechanics ranks.
feats.Get Radical!: Stunts are easier (–5 DC, –1 error), vehicle jumps go 50% farther, and your vehicle takes half falling damage.
feats.Need for Speed: No Maneuver penalty for going faster than half your vehicle or mount's top speed.
feats.Offensive Driving: Halved Maneuver penalties from Predator Strategies, and once per chase ignore a Crisis without a check.
feats.Relentless Pursuit: As Predator in a chase or manhunt, the starting Lead drops by 2 and every Strategy offers you the Lead Advantage.
feats.One Hand on the Wheel: No penalty for driving one-handed, plus free Maneuver checks per scene equal to your Chase feats.
feats.Simulator Jockey: No penalty for attacks and checks made through a drone, and you can Regroup while operating one.
feats.Ambush Basics: Deal 1 die of sneak attack damage, and Ambush checks you lead or help gain the Cross-Check tag.
feats.Ambush Mastery: Sense Motive synergy and +1 threat range on Ambush checks; set up a 1-minute ambush in a round (at +2 error).
feats.Ambush Supremacy: A second sneak attack die, prepare 1-hour ambushes in a minute, and Ambush threats cost 1 less action die.
feats.Bludgeon: Switch between lethal and subdual damage without penalty, including sneak attack damage.
feats.Whack: Subdual hits on flat-footed foes keep them flat-footed, and subdual sneak attacks deal +1 per die.
feats.Concealed Carry: Items stashed on you count as 2 Sizes smaller when you're frisked.
feats.Deadly Precision: Sneak attack damage deals +1 per die.
feats.No Quarter: Trade sneak attack dice for an equal increase in threat range on that attack.
feats.Crippling Strike: Your Cheap Shots on vulnerable foes impose an extra –1 penalty or –5 ft. Speed.
feats.Equilibrium Basics: Total Defense grants dodge Defense equal to your Covert feats, balancing is easier, and falls count as 20 ft. shorter.
feats.Equilibrium Mastery: Bonus to resist Trips equal to your Covert feats and much easier balancing on narrow or uneven surfaces.
feats.Equilibrium Supremacy: Dodge bonus when Fighting Defensively, and you can move through and end in enemy squares (flanking lone foes).
feats.Executioner: Once per round, Coup de Grace a helpless character as a half action.
feats.Merciless: Once per round, Coup de Grace a helpless character as a free action.
feats.Faceless: Sneak gives synergy to Blend, and anyone researching your past or whereabouts takes three times as long.
feats.Traceless: Blend gives synergy to Falsify, and checks to detect your presence or passage get harder by your Covert feats.
feats.Zeroed: Official records say you're dead; only exceptional investigation can prove otherwise.
feats.Ghost Basics: Move up to double Speed while sneaking, with extra synergy against sensors and living observers.
feats.Ghost Mastery: Smaller penalty for sneaking at speed, distracted observers suffer more, and better use of heavy cover.
feats.Ghost Supremacy: Hide with no apparent cover and sneak at speed without penalty.
feats.Mingling Basics: Blend/Stealth can always use Dex, crowds give synergy, and failing doesn't leave you flat-footed.
feats.Mingling Mastery: Halved Stealth penalties for moving or speaking, no Disposition tag, and you're invisible in crowds of 500+.
feats.Mingling Supremacy: No Stealth penalties for moving or speaking, smaller team/terrain penalties, and invisible in crowds of 50+.
feats.Spider Basics: No penalties while climbing (including without a kit), foes get no bonus against climbing you, and Initiative bonus when combat starts on a wall.
feats.Spider Mastery: Climb faster, catch yourself on most surfaces when falling, and take less falling damage.
feats.Spider Supremacy: Climb at full Speed, don't need extra checks when hurt while climbing, and climbing with a kit is easier.
feats.Clean and Polished: Errors with your Possessions cost opponents an extra action die to activate.
feats.Mother Hen: Your Possessions get +4 Damage saves, and you can take half the damage for them.
feats.Extra Gear: Gain one extra mission gear pick per Intel Phase in a chosen category. Can be taken multiple times.
feats.Electronic Warrior: Your electronic gear gets +2 Signal Rating and 25% more range.
feats.Micro-miniaturized: Gadget mechanisms are one Size smaller and each gadget can hold one more.
feats.Trap Master: Locks, sensors and traps you carry gain +2 Power Rating, and your traps deal +1 damage per die.
feats.Favored Gear: Gain one extra Possession (Caliber up to 1/3 your career level).
feats.Signature Gear: One Favored Gear item grants +1 to checks and damage and can't be destroyed by a critical failure.
feats.Trademark Gear: Your Signature Gear item's bonus rises to +2, and action dice spent on it roll twice.
feats.Tool Shed: Once per mission at home, find any Grade III kit that lasts the mission. Can be taken multiple times.
feats.Personal Stash: At home, add your Gear feats to Gear checks, and once per session make a Gear check without using a Reserve Common Item.
feats.Well-Funded: Once per mission at home, raise extra cash scaled to your Wealth, and you can take 10 on Bribe checks.
feats.Actor: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Bluff and Impress.
feats.Advisor: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Resolve and Profession.
feats.Burglar: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Acrobatics and Sneak.
feats.Diplomat: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Networking and Sense Motive.
feats.Examiner: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Analysis and Medicine.
feats.Fence: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Sleight of Hand and Streetwise.
feats.Hustler: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Falsify and Manipulate.
feats.Observer: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Notice and Search.
feats.Officer: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Intimidate and Tactics.
feats.Private Eye: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Investigation and Security.
feats.Scholar: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Bureaucracy and Science.
feats.Speed Demon: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Mechanics and Drive.
feats.Survivalist: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Athletics and Survival.
feats.Techie: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Computers and Electronics.
feats.World Traveler: +2 insight bonus and 19–20 threat range with Blend and Cultures.
feats.Advanced Skill Mastery: Improve one Basic Skill feat to +3 and 18–20 threat range, and re-roll one failed check with its skills each session.
feats.Grand Skill Mastery: Improve a mastered skill feat further to +4 and 17–20 threat range, with more re-rolls per session.
feats.Perfect Skill Mastery: Improve a Grand-mastered skill feat to +5 and 16–20 threat range, re-rolling up to 3 failed checks per session.
feats.False Start: For one Basic Skill feat's skills, abandon a failing long check partway through and restart it.
feats.Mark of a Professional: For one False Start feat's skills, –1 error range and unopposed checks take half the time.
feats.Practice Makes Perfect: For one Mark of a Professional feat's skills, natural rolls under 10 (that aren't errors) count as 10, and your errors are costlier to activate.
feats.Unfair Advantage: Every insight bonus you get to a skill check is 1 higher.
feats.Everyday Genius: As a full action, gain a Basic Skill feat you lack until the session ends; uses per mission equal to your Advanced Skill feats.
feats.Attention to Detail: Take 20 on checks with error ranges up to 2, lift the result cap when taking 20, and your secret checks gain Cross-Check.
feats.Depth of Study: Gain 2 extra skill focuses and/or fortes. Can be taken multiple times.
feats.I Can Swim: Hold skill points in reserve and spend them on the spot just before making a check.
feats.Photographic Memory: Knowledge checks can be active, gain +2 insight and 19–20 threat range, and you can take 10 or 20 on them quickly.
feats.Talented: Pick a Basic Skill feat's two skills: both become class skills and each rank bought in one also raises the other.
feats.Training: Gain 5 skill points that always buy full ranks, even in cross-class skills. Can be taken multiple times.
feats.Well Rounded: +5 result cap for skills with no ranks, action dice raise caps further, and ranks 1–3 always cost 1 point.
feats.Unlocked Potential: One skill becomes a class skill with max rank raised by 3, but you must keep it at that maximum.
feats.Academic Contacts: Gain an associate-grade contact with a academic background; Networking calls to them take half the time and are less error-prone.
feats.Animal Partner: Gain an animal companion whose strength scales with your Style and Terrain feats.
feats.Bloodstain Resistant: While dressed to your Lifestyle (and not in obvious armor), add your positive appearance modifier to Defense.
feats.Blue Collar Contacts: Gain an associate-grade contact with a tradesman or vehicle background; Networking calls to them take half the time and are less error-prone.

feats.Street Contacts: Gain an associate-grade contact with a street background; Networking calls to them take half the time and are less error-prone.

feats.Wilderness Contacts: Gain an associate-grade contact with a wilderness background; Networking calls to them take half the time and are less error-prone.

Advocate.core: Persistent: before the first Challenge of a Complex Task, spend and roll an action die to take 10 on that many Challenges.

abilities.Absolute Certainty: Add your class level to Wisdom for stress damage thresholds; winning an opposed Resolve check gives you a bonus on later opposed checks against that foe.
abilities.Behind the Scenes: A few times per mission (equal to your starting action dice), spend an hour with supporters to make one Request check automatically, up to DC 20 (DC 30 at 11th, DC 40 at 19th), without spending action dice.
abilities.Networks: Gain either a new associate-grade contact or an extra Gear feat.
abilities.By Any Means: Choose a skill: its error range drops by 2, taking 10 takes normal time, and it becomes a class skill. Pick another skill at each later By Any Means level.
abilities.Small Steps: Choose one Small Steps option (each only once).
abilities.Crusade: Once per session (twice at 20th), instead of rolling an opposed check with an Advocate class skill, set your result 1 higher than your opponent's.
abilities.True Believer: Once per session, rally listeners: for minutes equal to your Charisma score, standard characters you influence become much friendlier, ignore Morale checks and gain a bonus to act on your words.

options.Charm: Once per session, improve a non-villain NPC's attitude by one grade without a check.
options.Cover-up (city): Once per session, bury one event: investigations into it get harder by your class level.
options.Favor for a favor: You can bribe even honorable characters without penalty.
options.Inner Drive: Gain vitality equal to your class level and wounds equal to your Cha modifier (minimum 1).
options.Media Personality: Checks with the Remote tag take only a –4 penalty.
options.Professional Recognition: Experts who share one of your Profession focuses are automatically friendlier.

Explorer.core: Connected: spend 1d6 hours and an action die to track down an old acquaintance who acts as a contact with one skill of your choice, even in remote places.

abilities.All Over the World: If you fail an Athletics or Cultures check without an error, you still succeed when the DC is no higher than your class level + 20.
abilities.Bookworm: Research takes half the usual time (a quarter at 11th, a tenth at 19th), minimum 5 minutes.
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Basic Combat or Chance feat.
abilities.Uncanny Dodge: Progressive danger sense: keep Dex to Defense when flat-footed (I), never flanked (II), bonuses vs. traps and surprise attacks (III), halve Initiative Count losses (IV), never flat-footed (V).
abilities.The Notebook: Once per session (twice at 20th), reduce the Challenges needed in a Complex Task by your action dice.
abilities.Lifeline: Once per session, when you or an adjacent teammate would drop below 0 vitality, you can reduce the damage so vitality stops at 0.

Faceman.core: Doublespeak: as a free action, spend an action die to shift a target's attitude toward you and your allies by one grade for the scene.

abilities.1,000 Faces: Gain Flawless Identity; a few times per mission, add a special character you know to your stock of perfect identities.
abilities.Cold Read: Once per session on meeting someone, ask the GC personal questions about them (one per starting action die); extra uses at 11th and 19th.
abilities.Quick Change: Twice per session (more at higher levels), make a quick Hide or Disguise check as a free action without a kit.
abilities.Masks: Choose one Masks option (each only once).
abilities.Backup: Once per session (more often and stronger friends at 9th, 13th, 17th), call in a friend NPC to help you.
abilities.Smooth Operator: Once per mission (more at higher levels), gain a temporary Style feat during the Intel Phase.
abilities.Bald-Faced Lie: Once per session (twice at 20th), an NPC believes one lie as truth for minutes equal to your class level.
abilities.Doppelganger: Once per mission, perfectly impersonate a character you've studied.

options.Convincing: Once per session, spend an action die to force a re-roll of a successful check that would see through your disguise.
options.Favor for a Favor: You can bribe even honorable characters without penalty.
options.Fake It: +20 to Bluff when pretending to have a skill you don't.
options.Follow my Lead: Disguised teammates near you add your Cha modifier to their Disguise checks.
options.Old Debts: Backup friends arrive within 1d4 hours and are Helpful.

Hacker.core: Custom 'Ware: once per mission, load one computer with your software; you can spend action dice to boost its Power Rating.

abilities.Master Cracker: Once per session (more at 9th, 13th, 17th), decipher a code up to DC class level + 20 without a check.
abilities.Mad Skillz: Choose one Mad Skillz option (each only once).
abilities.Synchronized: At the start of a round, support a teammate (any number at 20th) with your computer skills.
abilities.Ghost in the Machine: Winning opposed checks in a hacking Conflict lets you wreak extra havoc on the target system.
abilities.Synchronization: At the start of a round, support a teammate (any number at 20th) with your computer skills.

options.Complex Substitution: Codes you create or request are 5 DC harder to decrypt.
options.Digital Fingerprints: Recognize other users' work and learn about their computer skills.
options.Hacker Culture: Skilled programmers are automatically friendlier toward you.
options.Hard-Wired: Pick 3 Hacker class skills that never suffer distraction or stress penalties.
options.Ice Man: Your system's Power Rating rises when you're the Prey in a hacking Conflict.
options.Intelligence Analysis: Computer research takes half the time.
options.Skill Mastery: Choose a class skill: –2 error range and taking 10 takes normal time.

Intruder.core: Dexterous: when you spend an action die on a Dexterity-based skill check, roll it twice and add both.

abilities.Gear Prep: Take one mission gear pick as if the mission Caliber were 1 higher.

abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Basic Combat or Covert feat.

abilities.Wildcard Gear: Once per session (twice at 20th), reveal you happen to have a small piece of useful gear on you.

options.Improvisation: As a full action, improvise one common item from whatever is at hand.

options.Skill Mastery: Choose a class skill: –2 error range and taking 10 takes normal time.
options.Stash It: Hidden objects on you are only found on a threat or critical success.
options.Tricky: When an adjacent foe misses you by 5 or more, you may Trick them for free.

Pointman.core: Generous: when a teammate who can see or hear you rolls, you can spend your action dice on their behalf.

abilities.Versatility: Choose 4 cross-class skills to become class skills, plus one more at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th.
abilities.Assistance: Raise a teammate's error range to cut the time their skill check takes (1/2, then 1/4 at 11th, 1/10 at 19th).

abilities.Serendipity: Once per session, a lucky break, helpful stranger or flash of inspiration arrives just when needed.

abilities.Flawless Search: If you fail an Analysis or Search check without an error, you still succeed when the DC is no higher than your class level + 20.
abilities.Intuition: As a 1-minute action, ask the GC for a free hint; if refused you gain action dice (more at 11th and 19th).
abilities.Intercept Communication: Once per session (more as you level), secretly intercept the next communication from a known location.
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Covert or Gear feat.
abilities.Spookshow: Choose one Spookshow option (each only once).
abilities.Black Hat: Once per mission (more at 12th and 18th), gain a temporary Tradecraft feat during the Intel Phase.
abilities.Big Brother: Once per mission (twice at 20th), place an area under surveillance and get a bonus feed from it.
abilities.Eye in the Sky: Gain permanent access to a top-tier spy satellite.
abilities.Abort!: Once per session (twice at 15th), when you or a teammate suffers an error, take the action back as if it never happened.

options.Complex Substitution: Codes you create or request are 5 DC harder to decrypt.
options.Current Dossier: Dossiers you get on special characters also list their current mission gear.
options.Intelligence Analysis: Computer research takes half the time.
options.No Worries: Skill checks using Tradecraft gear have –2 error range.
options.Skill Mastery: Choose a class skill: –2 error range and taking 10 takes normal time.
options.Spy vs. Spy: Take one Tradecraft gear pick as if the mission Caliber were 1 higher.
options.Subvert: During brainwashing, can force your subject to pick a different Strategy.
options.Wired for Sound: Plant items on a target that are only found on a threat or critical success.

Soldier.core: Accurate: when you spend an action die on an attack check, roll it twice and add both.

abilities.Fight On: Gain 2 weapon proficiencies or a Basic, Melee, Ranged or Unarmed Combat feat.
abilities.Armor Use: +1 Defense in armor (rising every 4 levels), lower armor check penalty, and an extra armor piece of growing Caliber.
abilities.Weapon Specialist: Choose a weapon proficiency and a Weapon Specialist option; later levels add another option or proficiency.
abilities.Portable Cover: You and nearby teammates always have some cover in combat (more at 20th).
abilities.One in a Million: Once per session, make one attack, Fortitude save or skill check an automatic best result.

options.Big Stick: Weapons of your chosen proficiencies count as one Caliber higher.
options.Foibles: +1 DR and +1 Defense against weapons of your chosen proficiencies.
options.Killer Instinct: +1d4 damage with chosen-proficiency weapons (ranged only at close range).
options.Most Deadly: Crits with chosen-proficiency weapons cost 1 less action die.
options.Mow Down: Once per round, one extra final attack against a standard character.
options.Showdown: Take Stand Off actions without spending action dice a few times per session.

Wheelman.core: Driven: when you spend an action die on a Maneuver or Mechanics/Repair check, roll it twice and add both.

abilities.Custom Ride: Take one Vehicle gear pick as if the mission Caliber were 1 higher.
abilities.Manual Adjustment: After failing a retryable Mechanics check, spend a half action to retry at once (Electronics at 11th, Security at 19th).
abilities.Crash Course: Gain 2 Drive focuses or a Chase feat.
abilities.Vehicle Familiarity: Each mission, choose familiar vehicles for a Maneuver bonus (+1 rising every 4 levels) and become familiar faster.
abilities.Driving School: Teammates in your vehicle benefit from your driving expertise.
abilities.Drivers Only: Choose one Drivers Only option (each only once).
abilities.Soup Her Up: Make improvements to a vehicle beyond its normal limits.
abilities.That's Impossible!: Once per session (twice at 20th), make a Maneuver check up to DC class level + 20 without rolling, or gain an edge in a chase.

options.Elbow Grease: +4 to Electronics and Mechanics checks to repair things.
options.Gunnery: Fire full-action vehicle weapons with a half action.
options.Most Lethal: Crits with vehicle weapons cost 1 less action die.
options.Pit Crew: Once per mission, summon expert mechanics.
options.Rough Riding: Mounts and ground vehicles you control count as off-road.
options.Skill Mastery: Choose a class skill: –2 error range and taking 10 takes normal time.
options.Spare Keys: Once per mission, replace a destroyed familiar vehicle.
options.Trade-In: Once per mission, return a familiar vehicle to regain its gear picks.
options.Vehicular Instinct: +1d4 damage with vehicle weapons at close range.

Brawler.core: Ferocious: when you spend an action die on damage with an unarmed or improvised weapon, roll it twice and add both.

abilities.Whatever's Handy: Bonus to damage and Defense while using an improvised weapon (+1, rising to +2 at 5th and +3 at 9th).
abilities.Cheap Shot: Unused threats with unarmed or melee attacks deal maximum damage (I); at 7th they also leave the target flat-footed (II).
abilities.Ploy: Choose one Ploy option (each only once).
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Melee Combat or Unarmed Combat feat.
abilities.Shrug It Off: Add your class level to Constitution for subdual damage thresholds.
abilities.Buff: Your Strength and Constitution each rise by 1.
abilities.Fight Club: Once per combat, share one of your Melee or Unarmed Combat feats with all teammates for that fight.
abilities.Juggernaut: When you take lethal damage, you may convert up to half of it to subdual damage.

options.Backhand: Deal subdual unarmed damage to gain +4 to Intimidate that foe for a minute.
options.Beat Down: Your unarmed and melee hits also deal 1 stress damage.
options.Quake Strike: As a full action, Trip several adjacent foes at once.
options.Smack Down: Plain unarmed Standard Attacks gain the takedown quality.
options.Stare Down: When you drop a foe, Threaten another nearby foe for free.
options.Still Standing: +8 to stay standing against takedown and bonuses against Bull Rush and Trip.
options.Strut: After a threat or crit, posture for a half action to gain a bonus action die.

Cleaner.core: Face in the Crowd: Notice and Search checks to find you or traces of you have their error range raised by half your class level.

abilities.Glib Explanation: Gain the Advanced Skill Mastery (Hustler) feat, then Grand at 5th and Perfect at 9th.
abilities.Priority Request: Bonus equal to your class level on Requests from certain gear categories (more categories at 7th).
abilities.Status Quo: Once per mission (more as you level), convince witnesses to disregard what they saw.
abilities.Red Herrings: Spend a round spoiling a 5-ft. square of evidence so forensic work there gets much harder.
abilities.Cleaning Crew: You and nearby teammates get synergy on checks to clean up evidence.
abilities.Must Complete Mission: Keep functioning through injuries that would normally take you out.
abilities.Fatal Attack: Spend an action die to make a potentially fatal attack against a vulnerable foe.

Con Artist.core: Two-Faced: you make all Bluff checks as active checks.

abilities.Short Con: Raise error range to finish Impress, Intimidate or Manipulate checks faster (1/2 time, 1/4 at 5th, 1/10 at 9th).
abilities.A Sucker Born Every Minute: Targets of your Mark feat are easier to fool (improved threat ranges at 7th).
abilities.No Hard Feelings: People you've wronged come around again; at 7th no one's attitude toward you can be worsened permanently.
abilities.Cool Customer: Calm tense situations down (at 8th the scene can't turn dramatic).
abilities.Shill: Successfully helping a teammate's Charisma check gives them an extra bonus.
abilities.Bait and Switch: Opponents who investigate you may be fed false conclusions (and penalties at 9th).
abilities.Shortest Way to the Heart: Gain an edge in seduction Conflicts before Strategies are chosen.
abilities.Long Con: Run elaborate cons over weeks or months for big payoffs.
abilities.100 Moves Ahead: Anyone investigating or reading you plays right into your hands.

Counter-Terrorist.core: Shoot First: in the surprise round and first round of combat, action dice you spend roll twice and add both.

abilities.Crowd Control: As a full action, order civilians out of the way.
abilities.Precision Takedown: Foes hiding behind bystanders or cover are easier for you to hit (cover counts 2 grades less at 7th).
abilities.Armor Use: +1 Defense in armor (+2 at 8th), lower armor check penalty, and an extra armor piece.
abilities.Safe Attack: Opponents need 2 extra action dice to make your attacks hit someone else.
abilities.SWAT: Once per mission, gain a temporary Covert feat during the Intel Phase (two at 9th).
abilities.Hostile Negotiator: Use Intimidate in place of the usual skill when negotiating under pressure.
abilities.Tactical Commander: Once per combat, lead a Joint Action with any number of teammates without a Tactics check.
abilities.First Strike: Once per combat, act before anyone else at the start of a round.

Field Analyst.core: Keen: you make all Notice checks as active checks.

abilities.CSI: Gain the Advanced Skill Mastery (Examiner) feat, then Grand at 5th and Perfect at 9th.
abilities.Priority Request: Bonus equal to your class level on Requests from certain gear categories (more categories at 7th).
abilities.All the Right Questions: Raise error range to finish Analysis, Investigation or Search checks faster (1/2 time, 1/4 at 7th).
abilities.Bright Idea: A few times per session, roll an Int- or Wis-based skill check twice and keep the better.
abilities.Plan of Action: Once per session, for a scene it costs an extra action die to activate your team's errors.
abilities.All the Right Answers: Complex Tasks keyed to Analysis, Investigation or Search start with progress already made.
abilities.Eye for Detail: Roll Search checks twice and keep the better.
abilities.Sum Up: Once per mission, brief your team so everyone gains bonuses from your findings.

Grunt.core: Hot-Blooded: gain a bonus action die at the start of each combat (two in dramatic scenes), and may pass one to a teammate.

abilities.Alpha Strike: Once per round, take Autofire or Strafe as a half action.
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Basic Combat or Ranged Combat feat.
abilities.Cool-Headed: Resistance to stress and subdual damage equal to your Con modifier.
abilities.Fire Team: At the start of combat, your team gains Autofire Basics (and Autofire Mastery at 8th) for the fight.
abilities.Heavily Armed: Take one Weapon gear pick as if the mission Caliber were 1 higher (two picks at 9th).
abilities.Put Your Backs Into It: Lend your raw strength to teammates' physical efforts.
abilities.Overkill: Crits with tactical or indirect weapons cost 1 less action die.
abilities.Battle Cry: Once per session, a fearsome cry shakes your opponents for the rest of the combat.

Guide.core: Cultured: you make all Notice checks as active checks.

abilities.Friends in Low Places: Canvass Area checks cost much less time and money (1/2, 1/4 at 5th, 1/10 at 9th).
abilities.Forage: Once per session, scrounge up a Common Item (or gear at 7th) with a Gear check.
abilities.Any Time, Any Place: Once per mission, gain a temporary Terrain feat.
abilities.Interpreter: Lead team Cultures, Streetwise and Survival checks more effectively.
abilities.Backup: Once per session (twice at 9th), call in a friend NPC to help you.
abilities.Overland Shortcut: Always take 10 on Knowledge checks to navigate.
abilities.Go Native: Roll Cultures checks twice and keep the better.
abilities.Master of Camouflage: While hidden in your home turf or the wild, you're very hard to find.

Illuminatus.core: Perfect Cover: spend and roll an action die to add its result to a cover identity's Power Rating for the scene.

abilities.Plausible Deniability: Gain an extra skill point per level; research into you suffers growing error ranges at 5th and 9th.
abilities.Permanent Record: You dig up secrets easily, and dossiers you gain are stronger at 7th.
abilities.Usual Suspects: When you use a cover identity, teammates get covers too (flawless ones at 7th).
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Covert or Tradecraft feat.
abilities.Terminally Harmless: Most opponents dismiss you at the start of combat.
abilities.Circumstantial Evidence: Blame for your actions under a cover identity slides off you.
abilities.Filed in Triplicate: Roll Bureaucracy checks twice and keep the better.
abilities.Shadow Cabinet: Exposure penalties against you are reduced.

Inventor.core: Technophile: spend an action die to automatically succeed at a Gear check or an Electronic or Gadget Request.

abilities.Utility Belt: Extra Reserve Common Items, and a growing bonus with Common Items you find.
abilities.Field Test: Declare a gear pick experimental for extra benefits (two picks at 7th).
abilities.Assembly: Once per session, build an item from a chosen gear table on the fly (more tables as you level).
abilities.Breakdown: Disable devices as if their Complexity were 10 lower.
abilities.Mark of a Professional: Gain the Mark of a Professional (Techie) feat.
abilities.Wildcard Gadget: Once per session (twice at 10th), reveal you happen to have a suitable small gadget.
abilities.Practice Makes Perfect: Gain the Practice Makes Perfect (Techie) feat.
abilities.Smartgun: Weapons you tune for yourself perform better in your hands.
abilities.Edison: Building devices with Assembly takes far less time.

Politico.core: Halls of Power: when you spend an action die on a Request check, also add its roll to the result.

abilities.Statesman: Gain the Advanced Skill Mastery (Diplomat) feat, then Grand at 5th and Perfect at 9th.
abilities.War Chest: During the Intel Phase, draw extra cash from backers (shared with your team at 7th).
abilities.Behind Closed Doors: Bonus on opposed Charisma-based checks in private dealings.
abilities.No Hard Feelings: People you've wronged come around again; at 8th no one's attitude toward you can be worsened permanently.
abilities.Security Detail: Bring a handpicked security detail on missions.
abilities.Diplomatic Solution: Once per scene, try to talk hostile opponents out of fighting.
abilities.Executive Decision: Take a Resource gear pick as if the mission Caliber were higher.

Raptor.core: Nimble: once per round, spend an action die to make a half-action Acrobatics check or a Feint as a free action.

abilities.Secret Weapon: Pick a melee or hurled weapon type as your signature: gain Favored Gear for it, then Signature Gear at 5th and Trademark Gear at 9th.
abilities.Wuxia: Jumps are no longer limited by your height and go much farther (more at 7th).
abilities.Cutting Edge: Take one Gadget gear pick as if the mission Caliber were 1 higher.
abilities.Cyclone: With your secret weapon, make a whirling attack against nearby foes (stronger at 8th).
abilities.Armor Grace: Partial armor gives extra Defense equal to your starting action dice.
abilities.Outrider: Once per mission, gain a temporary Chase feat.
abilities.Fleeting Shadow: Foes who were flat-footed this round have a hard time hitting you.

Schemer.core: Calculating: after rolling action dice, you may replace the lowest die with your Int modifier.

abilities.Mental Leap: Once per session (more as you level), add your starting action dice to Dex, Int or Wis temporarily.
abilities.Cunning Plan: Once per scene (twice at 7th), reduce a check's error range by your Int modifier.
abilities.Renaissance Man: Once per mission (twice at 7th), gain a temporary feat.
abilities.All According to Plan: Substitute a Tactics-planned result for a skill check.
abilities.Cross-Class Ability: Gain a package of abilities from a base class (see the Cross-Class options).
abilities.Evolved Mind: Gain 12 skill points, and every skill becomes a class skill.
abilities.Master Plan: Once per mission, gain bonus d4 action dice equal to your Int modifier.
abilities.Hyperconscious: Gain 24 skill points and take 10 more effectively on Int-based checks.

options.Advocate: Absolute certainty, behind the scenes I, networks, by any means.
options.Explorer: All over the world, bookworm I, bonus feat, uncanny dodge I.
options.Faceman: 1,000 faces, cold read, quick change, backup I.
options.Hacker: 'L337, master key I, trap door, bonus feat.
options.Intruder: Gear prep, evasion I, bonus feat, uncanny dodge I.
options.Scientist: Two intense study feats, Ph.D. in one skill, bright idea.
options.Scout: Stalker, rough living, bonus feat, sneak attack 1d6.
options.Sleuth: Human nature, sources I, little details, bonus feat.
options.Snoop: Flawless search, intuition I, intercept communication, bonus feat.
options.Soldier: Two fight on picks, fortunes of war I, armor use I.
options.Wheelman: Custom ride, manual adjustment I, driving school, vehicle familiarity +1.

Sniper.core: Eagle Eye: once per scene, spend and roll an action die to add 10× the result to a two-handed ranged weapon's range increment.

abilities.Expert Sharpshooter: Gain Sharpshooter Basics, then Mastery at 5th and Supremacy at 9th.
abilities.Surprise Shot: Bonus threat range with two-handed ranged weapons against flat-footed foes (+1, +2 at 7th).
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Covert or Terrain feat.
abilities.Ranged Sneak Attack: Braced two-handed ranged attacks deal sneak attack damage (more dice at 8th).
abilities.Perfect Killer: Choose one Perfect Killer option (each only once).
abilities.Magic Touch: BAB counts 1 higher for two-handed ranged attacks and Ranged Combat feat prerequisites.
abilities.Million Dollar Skill: Once per round, roll a two-handed ranged attack against a vulnerable foe twice and keep the better.

options.Nest: With half cover or better, use Tactics in place of Sneak.
options.Low-Light Vision: Ignore low-light vision penalties except total darkness.
options.One Shot: –2 error range with two-handed ranged weapons.
options.Tunnel Vision: Ignore fatigue while attacking with two-handed ranged weapons.

Stuntman.core: Adrenaline Junkie: gain a bonus action die whenever an attack, fall or explosion costs you wound points.

abilities.Life on the Edge: Gain wound points equal to your Chance feats and vitality equal to your class level.
abilities.No Fear: Add your class level to Wisdom for stress thresholds (I), then gain stress resistance at 7th (II).
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Chance or Chase feat.
abilities.Fall Guy: Falling and collision damage drops by 2 per die.
abilities.Trust Me: On team Acrobatics, Athletics or Drive checks, the team may use your bonus.
abilities.Insane Stunt: Once per session (twice at 9th), pull off a Maneuver up to DC class level + 20 without rolling.
abilities.It's All Relative: Spend a few actions getting a feel for any vehicle to handle it like a familiar one.
abilities.I Know What I'm Doing: Once per scene, gain a bonus on a very difficult Str- or Dex-based check.
abilities.School of Hard Knocks: Gain a bonus action die whenever an opponent activates your error.
abilities.Cheat Death: Once per session, survive a failed check or save that would kill you or fail the mission.

Tactician.core: Wily: once per round, spend an action die to take a Joint Action or Regroup as a free action.

abilities.Tempo: Use Surge of Speed more often (extra uses equal to class level); later, teammates and attacks benefit too.
abilities.Stratagem: Each round you and visible teammates gain Initiative Count (+1, +2 at 7th).
abilities.Art of War: Once per mission, gain a temporary Basic Combat feat (two at 7th).
abilities.Blood of Heroes: At the start of combat, you and teammates gain temporary vitality equal to your class level.
abilities.Orders: Advise allies once per session (twice at 8th) to grant them a synergy bonus.
abilities.Commanding Presence: Your Intelligence and Charisma each rise by 1.
abilities.Ten Against Ten Thousand: You and teammates who can see or hear you are never flanked or outnumbered.
abilities.Seize the Moment: Once per combat, declare a critical moment that flips the scene's standard/dramatic status for a round and boosts your team.

Transporter.core: Watchful: when you spend an action die to boost Defense, also add its roll to your Initiative Count.

abilities.Protect the Package: Designate a cargo (person, animal or item) that shares your Initiative and Reflex, later your cover identity (5th) and Defense (9th).
abilities.Take the Hit: Step in to take melee hits aimed at adjacent cargo (ranged hits too at 7th).
abilities.You Better Think Again: Bonus to Stand Offs while guarding cargo; at 7th, Stand Off attackers of your cargo for free.
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Basic Combat or Chase feat.
abilities.The Getaway: Once per session (twice at 8th) as chase Prey, use the "That's Impossible!" Strategy.
abilities.Evasion: When not flat-footed and a Reflex save would halve damage, a success means no damage.
abilities.The Switcheroo: Once per session, if your cargo is lost, it turns out you'd swapped it for a decoy.

Triggerman.core: Trigger-Happy: once per round during your Initiative Count, spend an action die to make a free final attack with a readied handgun.

abilities.Gunplay: Each handgun hit raises your Initiative Count by 1 (2 at 7th).
abilities.Gun-Fu: Disarm adjacent foes of firearms and use them yourself; at 7th, pay back damage you take with your next attack.
abilities.Eye of the Storm: Dodge bonuses against adjacent attackers (larger at 8th).
abilities.Uncanny Dodge: Keep Dex to Defense when flat-footed; never flanked at 8th.
abilities.Bonus Feat: Gain a Ranged or Unarmed Combat feat.
abilities.Bag Full of Guns: Once per mission, produce a bag full of guns Resource pick.
abilities.Both Guns Blazing: No penalties for multiple attacks or final attacks.

Virtuoso.core: Meticulous: –2 error range with your key skill, and once per scene spend an action die to re-roll a key-skill check.

abilities.Field of Expertise: Choose a key skill (6+ ranks): it's always a class skill and gets an extra skill point each level; later gain its Advanced (3rd), Grand (5th), False Start (7th) and Perfect (9th) mastery feats.
abilities.Versatility: Choose 2 cross-class skills to become class skills (2 more at 7th).
abilities.Brain Trust: People you successfully direct with your expertise gain lasting benefits.
abilities.Professional Courtesy: Experts in your key skill are friendlier toward you (more at 8th).
abilities.Ph D: Choose a class skill: its maximum rank becomes career level + 8.
abilities.Bamboozle: Others accept your expert claims as fact, true or not.
abilities.Breakthrough: Once per scene, apply your key skill's expertise to a related Int or Wis check.
